decisions.reason: The chart plugin builds directly on the firm's web map applications and shows active releases, indicating strong absorptive capacity to assimilate feedback and improve it.
The hierarchical search plugin is close to established search capabilities, and the firm's own R&D enables it to interpret results and refine the product.
The mobile map layer control leverages existing GIS components and was highlighted on the home page, suggesting ongoing learning and strategic fit.
As the flagship platform closely tied to core GIS solution knowledge and strategic direction, its related knowledge base makes dropping highly unlikely.
The mobile field data capture software uses existing mobile and GIS capabilities, and its dedicated page indicates active market presence and learning potential.
This search extension is close to the established web map portfolio, and absorptive capacity supports keeping it to assimilate user feedback and improve.
